testing_authorizations.playwright: n/a - authorized: the target codebase is the CT6 plugin itself (markdown instruction surfaces + stdlib Python engines); it ships no frontend, no routes, no UI. Its user-experience layer IS the hook/CLI behavior, verified by pytest behavior tests against fixtures. No requirement in scope has a UI surface.
testing_authorizations.dev_api_integration: n/a - authorized: no API endpoints exist or are touched; the services tier is out of scope for this change. The deterministic engines' CLI surfaces are exercised directly by tests (the repo's equivalent of endpoint testing).
testing_authorizations.both_layer_integration: n/a - no requirement spans frontend+backend; all entries are layer infra by the repo's established convention (see opus-5-model-upgrade coverage map).
